correctness.rationale: Exact intersecting/disjoint target-pair witness criteria are proven, including the exclusion of endpoints. Two isolates and every nontrivial tree component violate the triple criterion; every nontrivial component must contain a cycle, giving >=n-1 selected pairs. Equality plus uniqueness of isolate and absence of leaves forces disjoint cycles; triangles violate triple criterion and four-cycles violate four-cut criterion. Conversely cycles >=5 plus an isolate satisfy both. Labelled exponential-cycle enumeration proves the complete number. Direct finite witness-mask verification on n<=8 and independent integer coefficients check boundaries without replacing the proof.
